fato_historico: 1087: William II is crowned King of England, and reigns until 1100.

You may find that your gentle spirit gains new strength, helping you cultivate harmony in your home and personal kingdom as you build your future foundations.
frase_do_dia: Claim your crown and lead your heart with courage, kindness, and deep grace.
